decisions.reason: The same source message already introduces the raised platform and its cup-clearance purpose completely; no additional propagated MODIFY is needed.
Mounting the spouts flush with the machine bottom does not change their removability, flushing method, or cleanability requirements.
The spout mounting and cup-clearance platform decision does not alter mixing quality, foam production, whisk geometry, or whisk positioning.
The source changes physical spout placement and addresses cup clearance, but leaves valve control, flow behavior, feed method, and dispensing sequence unchanged.
The source does not change the requirement to prevent liquid from entering the base or electrical components.
Flush bottom placement does not modify the required leak-free seal behavior of the plumbing connection.
The source does not address or alter placard wording, placement, duplication, or viewing orientation.
The mechanical platform and spout-position decision does not change electrical loads, controller configuration, supply capacity, or overload margin.
The source concerns spout clearance beneath the enclosure and does not change bowl capacity, depth, geometry, or enclosure-size constraints.
The source does not affect whisk removability, tool-free detachment, or clearance for bowl removal.
Adding support beneath the mixer does not change the required bowl removal, swapping, or upper assembly clearance behavior.
The reference to the beige render identifies the depicted configuration but does not modify the already established beige and green color scheme.
